tasks.label: api-probe
tasks.detail: Chẩn đoán: chạy API 20s và ghi toàn bộ output ra file
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue '${workspaceFolder}/.api-out.txt','${workspaceFolder}/.api-err.txt'; $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'dotnet' -ArgumentList 'run','--project','${workspaceFolder}/backend/LanguageCenter.Api/LanguageCenter.Api.csproj','--launch-profile','http','--no-build' -RedirectStandardOutput '${workspaceFolder}/.api-out.txt' -RedirectStandardError '${workspaceFolder}/.api-err.txt' -PassThru -NoNewWindow; Start-Sleep -Seconds 20; Write-Output ('HAS_EXITED=' + $p.HasExited); if (-not $p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force }"
